#### Sustainable Farming

# Starts With Us

[Learn More](mailto:info@intersectag.com)

### What We Do

Intersect Agriculture is a vertical indoor farm focused on converting waste into nutrients through rearing insects in a net carbon negative-process.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/634847f1098ab52d27871daf/63f57031-2724-4492-a379-79d014024644/Blue+IA+Logo.png)

### Our Mission & Vision

Our mission is to improve the value of waste by feeding our food from the ground up as a sustainable, responsible, and equitable steward of our land and community.
